scripts.build: tsc && webpack --config webpack.config.cjs && npm run build:page
scripts.build:page: npm --prefix src/page run build && node --input-type=module -e "import {rmSync,cpSync} from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist/src/page',{recursive:true,force:true}); cpSync('src/page/dist','dist/src/page',{recursive:true});"
